To Be Sixteen Again Chapter 15: Flexing Like the Wind, Always by My Side

In the classroom of Class 5, Year 3, on the second floor of the old teaching building's west wing.

Starting from noon, students had already begun arriving at school one after another.

After all, graduation was imminent, and most of the classmates would scatter to different high schools.

Even if they ended up at the same high school, they might not be in the same class.

So everyone cherished what was likely their last chance to see each other.

Students with closer relationships were already sharing their high school entrance exam scores, making plans to apply to the same high school.

"It's okay. A score of 508 isn't a sure thing, but there's still a good chance," Vice Class President Shao Heqi said reassuringly to Jin Yuting near the teacher's podium. "Didn't last year's cutoff line end up being only 507?"

"But the cutoff lines for the year before and the year before that were both above 510," Jin Yuting sat in the front row, crestfallen and very upset, her heart pounding with anxiety.

The educational resources in Yinjiang District were not as good as the main urban area, and the gap in quality among high schools was especially stark.

In the entire Yinjiang District, besides Yuhang Fuyi High School which was a true provincial key high school that could compete with the top high schools in the city, the rest of the schools were mostly mid-to-lower tier.

If she couldn't get into the Fuyi High, Jin Yuting would have no choice but to go to No. 2 High, which only had a 40% college acceptance rate.

Although No. 2 High could be considered mid-tier in all of Yuhang City, compared to the Fuyi High, it was like heaven and earth.

"There's no point in thinking so much about it now," Xu Yinghuan shook her head helplessly beside them. "The score is what it is. All we can do is pray this year's cutoff line is a little lower."

In the class, aside from the two celestial beings Ying Chanxi and Zhao Rongjun, the three of them had the best grades.

At this moment, with the three of them gathered together discussing the cutoff score for the Fuyi High, other students naturally wouldn't come over and ask for a snub.

After all, even Jin Yuting, who had the lowest score among the three, was still at least ten or twenty points higher than anyone else.

The vast majority of the other students in the class would, after the entrance exam, mediocrely enter various regular high schools or even vocational high schools.

From then on, they would embark on completely different paths in life.

…

Just as everyone was chatting.

The homeroom teacher, Zhang Wei, walked in from outside the classroom, holding a transcript.

He smiled and patted the head of a mischievous student in the back row, telling him to get off the desk, and then said, "You did well this time. You probably won't have to go to a vocational high school."

"Hehe." The student rubbed his head and chuckled, puffing out his chest with pride. "I must have guessed at least five or six more multiple-choice questions right in English!"

"You're the worst. My damn English score was only seventy," complained his underachieving friend next to him. "This morning, my parents ganged up on me. I was so scared I didn't even eat lunch and rushed straight to school."

"That's because you're usually unwilling to work hard," Zhang Wei shot him a displeased look, feeling disappointed. "If you were willing to learn from Li Luo, you wouldn't have ended up in a vocational high school."

"Li Luo?" The underachiever was taken aback and couldn't help but ask curiously, "Teacher Zhang, did Li Luo do very well this time?"

"Yes," Zhang Wei's mouth twitched. "He did indeed do well."

Jin Yuting in the front row was already feeling down. Hearing what Zhang Wei said, she immediately turned her head and pressed, "Teacher Zhang, was Li Luo's score high enough for the regular high school cutoff?"

"The regular high school cutoff..." Zhang Wei paused for a moment, then nodded with a wry smile. "Of course, it was enough."

"I see..." Jin Yuting fell silent, her mood worsening.

It wasn't that she was envious, but the thought that Li Luo had performed exceptionally well on the exam while she herself had suffered a Waterloo.

And to think she had laughed at him before the exam...

But at least she had scored 508. Even if Li Luo did well, the most he could get was probably over 430.

With that thought, Jin Yuting's mood improved slightly, as if she had found some comfort.

"Everyone, please take your seats first," after bantering with the students for a bit, Zhang Wei walked up to the podium and instructed the class. "Let me see how many people are still missing."

At that moment, Li Luo and his two friends, who had been taking pictures outside, timely entered through the back door.

Hearing Teacher Zhang's words, Li Luo walked to his seat by the window in the back row and sat down, still pondering what Teacher Zhang had said earlier.

A surprise?

What surprise?

Li Luo couldn't figure it out at the moment.

On the podium, Zhang Wei saw that everyone was seated. He glanced around and confirmed that only two or three people were still absent.

He checked the time; it was already two-thirty in the afternoon.

So he placed the transcript in his hand on the podium and said to everyone with a smile, "You've probably all checked your scores, right? I'll also share our class's overall performance here."

"In this high school entrance exam, some people performed very well, while others had some minor slip-ups. But overall, our class has shown improvement."

As he spoke, Zhang Wei looked down at the transcript and continued.

"Our class has a total of 45 students. This time, there are 16 students with scores below 420."

"There are 20 students with scores between 420 and 460."

"There are 5 students with scores between 460 and 500."

"And there are a total of 4 students with scores above 500."

"Tomorrow at noon, the application system for high schools will open. If any of you have questions about filling out your applications, feel free to consult me anytime during this period."

"Just in case, I'll write my phone number and QQ number on the blackboard. Students who haven't saved it before, please do so."

As he spoke, Zhang Wei had already picked up a piece of chalk and was briskly writing his phone number and QQ number on the blackboard.

Meanwhile, below the podium, Shao Heqi was frowning deeply, wondering how their class could have 4 students with scores above 500.

If there had been a fourth person who scored above 500, they would have already been bragging about it in the QQ group, right?

With this confusion, Shao Heqi waited for Teacher Zhang to finish writing on the blackboard, then couldn't help but raise his hand and ask, "Teacher Zhang."

"What is it?"

"You said our class has 4 students with scores above 500. Besides me, Xu Yinghuan, and Jin Yuting, is there anyone else?"

Hearing Shao Heqi's question, the other students in the class grew curious as well.

Their eyes darted around at their classmates, landing on a few who usually had decent grades.

But these students were also clueless, looking left and right, unsure who it could be.

Seeing this, Zhang Wei on the podium couldn't help but chuckle and shake his head. "Hmm... about that."

"I have to commend our classmate Li Luo. He also scored above 500 this time, showing great improvement."

"I was shocked when I saw the transcript too. It's normal that you guys couldn't guess."

The moment Zhang Wei finished speaking.

The gazes of all the surrounding students instantly, in perfect unison, turned to the guy in the back row by the window, who was resting his chin on his hand and leisurely looking at the scenery outside.

These gazes were filled with astonishment, disbelief, and utter shock. Li Luo had to exert great effort to barely suppress the corner of his mouth from curling up.

It had to be said, even a 35-year-old soul couldn't resist the thrill of such a flex.

Especially when it was the homeroom teacher who initiated the assist, without him having to lift a finger.

So this was the pleasure that good grades could bring?

"He could score that high?!" Jin Yuting in the front row turned to look at Li Luo, her face filled with shock.

She herself had only scored 508, yet Li Luo had also scored above 500.

Doesn't that mean Li Luo was only a few points behind her???

If the cutoff for the Fuyi High was high this year, could it be that she and Li Luo would both end up at No. 2 High?

At this thought, Jin Yuting's expression instantly turned ugly.

Especially when she remembered her taunts towards Li Luo before the exam, and now compared their nearly identical scores, Jin Yuting wished she could find a hole to crawl into.

"Li Luo's score was just over four hundred before, right? Is he really that amazing?" On the other side, Xu Yinghuan couldn't help but cover her mouth in surprise. Then she quickly stood up and went to the podium to look at the transcript in Zhang Wei's hand.

"Teacher Zhang, Teacher Zhang, can I please have a look? I want to see Li Luo's score!"

Riding on her status as a good student, Xu Yinghuan was quite lively in front of the teachers, often acting cute and whatnot.

Zhang Wei was clearly used to this girl's style and smilingly handed her the transcript. "Here, take a look."

Xu Yinghuan eagerly took the transcript, subconsciously looking for people below Jin Yuting.

But after scanning twice, she found that the scores after Jin Yuting all started with a 4.

This made her pause for a moment. She looked up and was immediately dumbfounded.

"What's the score? Xu Yinghuan, say something!" a classmate shouted from below the podium, not forgetting to tease, "It can't be higher than our academic representative's score, can it?"

Few people believed this statement.

Jin Yuting even let out a couple of "hehs," thinking that for Li Luo to score 500 was already a miracle from his ancestors. How could it possibly be higher than Xu Yinghuan's 520?

If that were the case, wouldn't Li Luo be able to get into the Fuyi High?

And as Jin Yuting was thinking this, Ying Chanxi, who was sitting next to her, had a smile on her face. She propped her chin on her hands and looked at Xu Yinghuan, her eyes squinting with enjoyment as she appreciated the surprised expressions on her classmates' faces.

Anyone who didn't know would have thought they were looking at her own transcript.

But seeing Li Luo's score shock the class so much made Ying Chanxi happier than if she had gotten first place in the entire school herself.

Her legs under the desk couldn't help but swing back and forth.

At this moment, Xu Yinghuan had just come back to her senses. She looked at the transcript in her hand with a dazed expression, then raised her head to look at her classmates, her tone wavering and uncertain as she said:

"Li Luo... scored 555?"

Instantly, the classroom fell completely silent.

As if someone had pressed the mute button.

They could even clearly hear Teacher Wang's voice from the next classroom.

Jin Yuting in the front row was stunned.

Shao Heqi in the third row was also dumbfounded, then he mentally recalled his own score... damn it, he thought he only got 554, right?

Li Luo got 555.

Doesn't that mean... Li Luo scored better than him?!

Who are you kidding!

Shao Heqi shot up from his seat, strode to the podium, snatched the transcript from Xu Yinghuan's hands, and stared hard at it.

Li Luo—Total score 555!

It was written clearly in black and white.

Other bolder students also ran up at this point, crowding around Shao Heqi to take a look, followed by a series of sharp intakes of breath.

"Holy crap! How the hell did he get that score?"

"Li Luo, did you cheat?"

"This is insane, it really is 555!"

Surrounded by a circle of amazed gasps, Shao Heqi felt his head grow a little dizzy from lack of oxygen, and his whole body felt light-headed.

He couldn't for the life of him figure out how Li Luo, who had only scored around 420 on the mock exams, had managed to get this score on the actual entrance exam.

"Teacher Zhang, couldn't there be a mistake in calculating Li Luo's score?" one student jokingly asked, voicing the doubt in Shao Heqi's heart.

But Zhang Wei just shook his head. "His situation is special. The school specifically inquired about it and his papers were reviewed. There's no problem with Li Luo's score."

Hearing Zhang Wei's final verdict, Shao Heqi's fingers gripping the transcript tightened even more.

He was supposed to be number one after Ying Chanxi and Zhao Rongjun!

How did he suddenly become the fourth in the class?

Although Li Luo's high score didn't affect his own admission into the Fuyi High.

But looking at the mere one-point difference, Shao Heqi felt worse than if he had eaten shit.

Especially after catching the smiling look in Ying Chanxi's eyes, Shao Heqi felt an even greater sense of awkwardness and bitterness.

With this thought, Shao Heqi carefully examined Li Luo's score for each subject.

In the end, he found that apart from Science, where he scored over one hundred and fifty and had an absolute advantage, he was outscored by Li Luo in every other subject.

Especially Chinese. How the hell did he score 110?!

Among the three main subjects, Chinese was the hardest to get a high score in.

In Shao Heqi's memory, only Ying Chanxi could consistently score above 110 in the class.

Even Zhao Rongjun couldn't guarantee that score every time.

At this thought, Shao Heqi found it even harder to accept this reality.

No matter how he racked his brain, he couldn't figure out how Li Luo had done it.

But by now, Zhang Wei had already taken the transcript back from them, clearing his throat and telling them to return to their seats.

Shao Heqi returned to his seat in a daze, subconsciously glancing back at Li Luo, only to see Li Luo give a proud smile towards the front and make a 'V' sign with his hand.

Following Li Luo's gaze back to the front, Shao Heqi saw Ying Chanxi turning to look at Li Luo, giving him a thumbs-up and winking playfully.

At this moment.

Shao Heqi's ears were filled with a profound silence, hearing only the crunching sound of bare feet stepping on shattered glass.

Oh.

It wasn't shards of glass.

It was his heart, shattered.

"Alright, quiet down," Zhang Wei said from the podium. "Now, let's go over the arrangements for the graduation ceremony."
